mapper.select: SELECT id FROM async_task WHERE task_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE async_task SET status='CANCELED',version=version+1,lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL, finished_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),last_result_code='OWNER_CANCELED' WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('READY','RETRY_WAIT','RUNNING')

UPDATE async_task_attempt SET result='NOOP',error_code='OWNER_CANCELED',finished_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), duration_ms=GREATEST(0,TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND,started_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) DIV 1000) WHERE task_id=#{id} AND finished_at IS NULL
